item.title: Explained: Why the US is lifting additional 25$ duty on India over Russian oil, what New Delhi promised in return, and more
item.description: The rollback of duties will take effect from February 7, according to an executive order issued by the White House.

item.title: 'Reflects growing depth, trust, dynamism': PM Modi on India-US interim trade pact, thanks Donald Trump
item.description: PM Modi further noted that the India-US interim trade deal framework strengthens the government's flagship 'Make in India'.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: PCB seeks government advice on Sri Lanka's plea to reconsider India match boycott
item.description: The PCB has assured Sri Lanka Cricket that a decision will be made after further consultation with the government.

item.title: 'Farmers safe, country developed': Piyush Goyal says India's agri exports to go up
item.description: Goyal said that dairy, fruits, vegetables, spices, and other grains have been protected. Check out the list of agricultural goods, vegetables, and spices that the US cannot export to India

item.title: India-US interim trade pact: From diamonds to silk — Full list of products under 18% tariffs
item.description: From the glittering diamond hubs of Surat to the textile clusters of Tiruppur, industries that were previously "priced out" of the US market are suddenly back in the game.

item.title: India, US to boost trade in GPUs, advanced tech under interim pact framework
item.description: The framework, unveiled after talks between US President Donald J. Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, positions high-end computing hardware as a core pillar of a broader US–India push on supply-chain resilience, digital trade and strategic technology cooperation.

item.title: Q3 results: HAL, Titan, M&M, HUL, ONGC, Lenskart to post earnings next week; check dates
item.description: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), Indian Hotels Company, Lupin, Bharat Forge, Biocon, Muthoot Finance, Petronet LNG and others are also scheduled to report earnings on Thursday.

item.title: BDL, Mazagon Dock, MRF, Hindustan Copper, RVNL, others to turn ex-dividend next week
item.description: On Thursday, Procter & Gamble Health would trade ex-dividend for a total of Rs 160 per share, comprising a special dividend of Rs 50 and an interim dividend of Rs 110 with a face value of Rs 10 each.
